description: Minor and patch updates arrive as one PR per place they ship, so each PR has one deploy step. Majors keep a PR each. Apart from Security PRs, Renovate opens and updates PRs only on its Monday schedule (updateNotScheduled), so a rebase doesn't start a Netlify build midweek.

packageRules.description: The Playground ships when Netlify deploys the merge.
The Writers' Lambdas ship with cdk deploy.
The WordPress plugin ships when a site pins the new commit.
Build, lint, test and CI tooling runs only in CI, so green checks cover it.
GitHub Actions majors join Tooling too: they run only in CI, so a failing check is the whole risk.
bdt-customisations stays on PHPUnit 9: PHPUnit 13 needs PHP 8.4, yoast/phpunit-polyfills supports up to PHPUnit 12, and dms/phpunit-arraysubset-asserts up to 10.
TypeScript stays on 5.x until the toolchain moves to TypeScript 7, the native compiler: ts-node (cdk synth) and ts-jest load the JavaScript compiler API it doesn't have.
